scripted_model_responses.content: Hello. This scenario is scripted (fixture-only) and doesn't actually hit any provider — the fixture short-circuit in model_call.py runs before the provider is even resolved. To exercise the real Anthropic provider end-to-end, delete this scenario's rows from _test_scripted_responses and configure a tier with LANGUAGE_MEDIUM_PROVIDER=anthropic + LANGUAGE_MEDIUM_MODEL=claude-3-5-sonnet-... + LANGUAGE_MEDIUM_API_KEY=sk-ant-... (BASE_URL is optional for anthropic). See docs/components/model-registry.md.
